title: Manager: small fixes left by task 058 (substitution inside a forced deletion, main-folder recommendation, orphaned pushes(), commit-message advice for builders)
item: Fix the minor problems review 058-1, review 058-2 and advisor 058-2 left in the deletion checks and the hook
motivation: None blocked task 58, but one lets a forced deletion of an unconfirmed branch through the hook, and one gives wrong advice in the run report.
notes: Review 058-2: (2) a forced deletion of a confirmed branch followed by $(echo owner-idea) is allowed, and bash also deletes owner-idea; refuse a forced deletion whose text holds $(, a backtick or $; (3) when the main folder has the branch checked out, superseded recommends git worktree remove on the main folder, which git refuses; it should say switch the main folder back (test_deletion.py asserts the wrong text); (4) pushes() in checks.py is now called by nothing; (5) commands/manage.md step 7 prescribes a double-quoted merge -m, so a title holding $ changes the subject; (6) the heredoc and -F advice is not in agents/builder.md, so builders' heredoc commits naming refused commands are refused mid-run; (7) the docs test checks only that strings appear; (8) SKILL.md rule 6 says two cases so far but lists four. Review 058-1: forced-deletion match misses abbreviated long options (--del --forc); the hook checks superseded in the event's cwd repo. Advisor 058-2: known holes needing -m inside another quoting context (echo ' -m " ...', bash -c with a single-quoted message inside double quotes, bash -cm); consider a refusal hint to use a plain quoted -m or -F. Outside: step 7 cleanup looks only at task/<id>* branches, never iterate branches or parked tasks' branches. Dropped 2026-11-17: folded into task 066, the one manager loose-ends task. This file stays as the list of what task 066 fixes.
done_means: (1) While a manager run is active, the hook allows a forced branch deletion only when the branches bash will delete are the ones `checks.py superseded` confirmed. It refuses with exit 2, also when every branch written in plain text is confirmed: a command whose text holds `$` or a backtick (`git branch -D task/001 $(echo owner-idea)`, the same with backticks, `git branch -D task/001 $B`); a command that runs anything besides the one `git branch` call (`cd <another clone> && git branch -D task/001`); and a call that points git at another repository (`git -C <path> branch -D task/001`, `--git-dir`, a `GIT_DIR=` prefix). It reads git's abbreviated long options as the full ones, so `git branch --del --forc <name>` is refused for a branch that is not confirmed. The refusal names the allowed form, `git branch -D <name>` alone in its command once `checks.py superseded <name>` passes, and that form is still allowed for a confirmed branch from the main folder and from a worktree of the same repository, written with `-D`, `--delete --force`, `-d -f` or `-df`. SKILL.md's hook entry and commands/manage.md step 7 state the same rule. Tests in temporary repos cover each refused form, with a confirmed branch and an existing unconfirmed one, and the allowed form. (2) `checks.py superseded`, for a branch of a merged task that fails only because the main folder has it checked out, with no file only on the branch, recommends deleting it once the main folder is switched back to the working branch, names that branch, and does not mention `git worktree remove`, which git refuses for the main folder. For a branch checked out in a worktree under `build/worktrees/` its output is unchanged. The main-folder case of `test_superseded_checked_out_branch_kept` asserts the new text and that `git worktree remove` is absent. (3) commands/manage.md step 7 prescribes a form of the task merge's commit in which bash expands nothing in the title, and SKILL.md's hook entry gives the same form. Followed as written while a run is active, for a title holding each of `$HOME`, `$(date)`, a pair of backticks, a double quote, a single quote, and the words `git clean`, the hook allows the commit and its subject is `Merge task <id>: <title>` character for character. A test in a temporary repo runs each title through the hook and through bash and compares the subject `git log` prints. (4) agents/builder.md step 4 tells the builder to write a commit message in single quotes, or in a file given with `git commit -F <file>` when it holds a single quote, and never as a heredoc or a `$(cat ...)` substitution, because while a run is active the hook reads those as commands and refuses a message that names `git push`, `git clean` or a forced branch deletion. When the hook refuses a command that also runs `git commit`, its message ends by saying the same: a message that only names the refused command goes in single quotes or in a file given with `-F`. Tests assert that sentence on the heredoc commit `test_deletion.py` already refuses, and its absence from the refusal of a bare `git push` and a bare `git clean -fd`. (5) Leftovers. `scripts/checks.py` no longer defines `pushes`, and no file under .claude/skills/manage/ calls it. SKILL.md rule 6 no longer says Two cases so far: it gives no count, or the count of the cases it lists, and attributes to task 49 only the two that came from it. SKILL.md's hook entry lists, among what the hook misses, a `-m` that sits inside another quoted string, a heredoc body or a comment, and `bash -cm`, the three forms recorded in tasks/advice/058-2.md; this task does not close them. (6) `uv run --with pytest pytest .claude/skills/manage/tests` passes, all of it, and `tasks.py lint` passes. Apart from the task's own file under tasks/, the diff changes no file outside .claude/skills/manage/, and .claude/settings.json is unchanged. Every hook case the tests asserted before this task still gets the same exit code: push, `git clean` and an unconfirmed forced deletion refused, a commit message that bash runs nothing in allowed, `rm` allowed, nothing refused when no run is active. The only existing assertion that changes is the main-folder recommendation of line 2.

decided_for_you.chosen: Advisor job d drafted the fields from task 058, tasks/advice/065-1.md; line (1) refuses a forced deletion with anything besides the one git branch call in its command
decided_for_you.would_change: If the manager must chain the cleanup deletion with other commands, you want the hook to be proof or its three holes closed, or you want a fixed order between 64 and 65; see the reply's owner's calls 1-4 and choices 5-8
